title: Check what a picture implies
statement: Check every generated or repainted picture by eye against its brief and the text, and draw maps and diagrams from data.
example: 1 of 18 repaints added people to an empty room and still passed my frame check.
detail:
The film's treatment asked for cuts to be revised if they imply someone is present where the text does not place them
(`g9/film/TREATMENT.md`). In 1 of 18 repaints the image model added two people to an empty room and put out its last
candle, and the frame check passed it, because it confirmed which file was on screen, not what it showed
(`othello-unit-video/.claude/skills/uvk-art-make/SKILL.md`; `othello-unit-video/research/METHODS.md`, "Limits"). The
kit also records 1 in 22 finished paintings coming back with a paper border drawn in, faces moving 30 to 60 pixels
after a repaint, and a generated map putting places in the wrong spots, so maps are drawn from public map data
(`unit-video-kit/.claude/skills/uvk-art-make/SKILL.md`, `unit-video-kit/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`).

a generated cover image duplicated a pinned character — 5 children shown instead of a pinned cast of 4. **Mechanism:** cast pinning inside a CAST block in the prompt is not enough; the model drifts on count once past roughly four figures, and pinning the count in only one place in the prompt doesn't anchor it. **Fix:** repeat the EXACT-N count inside the SCENE line itself (not just the CAST block), use explicit separation language, and enumerate individually for stubborn cases; EYEBALL every generated image before wiring it into `art.ts`.
